objective: Prototype source-first subject/relation/scope and formula constraints after independent NLI failed to protect exact-bound answers, without repeating old generation or weakening support gates.
instructions:
Inspect the sealed task221 repair and task222 reuse record first. Do not regenerate the old60-question matrix, rerun its same-model audit, or search thresholds/seeds. The independent NLI experiment retained8/40 useful old answers but admitted s10 role/property transfer, s22 codification confusion, n07 temporal transfer, r09 wrong root, and p08 first-becoming; rebinding even damaged the positive p01 source link. Preserve all103 replay/probe records and the fixed994 raw classifier pairs. This is public development/regression work, never private holdout or acceptance.
Implement one declared source-first fact-frame constraint prototype before permitting NLI scores to suggest eligibility: extract subject, relation, input/output arguments, required condition/time scope and numeric/formula structure from exact available source spans, and compare every complete generated claim's factual clauses to those frames. Use a pinned licensed independently trained dependency/semantic-role parser if needed, with measured host resources and recorded extraction errors. Parser labels and frame matches are fallible; independently source-inspect every final eligible claim. NLI may veto but must not alone establish support. Unknown relation/scope or unparsed factual tail must withhold the whole claim. Never silently delete a false tail or rewrite an answer to an extractive quote. Do not implement case-ID, article-title, entity-name or expected-label allowlists, handcrafted answers, or unreported lexical approval heuristics.
The bounded supported relation families are input versus product/property ownership, definition constraints (single comprehensive versus arbitrary written set), start versus continued temporal roles, and explicit mathematical root/ratio interpretation. A deterministic formula adapter must parse actual TeX root degree/radicand and check numeric meaning with declared tolerances; matching the decimal token is insufficient. Exact typed source offsets, edition provenance, conditions and visible subject context must survive rendering. Test the known source-faithful repairs l11/r06 and the damaged p01/n02 links, not only rejection counts.
Freeze at least20 new public paired source-faithful cases across four areas before parser/controller changes or candidate generation, including different named subjects and paraphrases, compound tails, positive false-premise corrections and absent evidence; pin real excerpts and expectations. Keep all existing generator/model pins and production model.env unchanged. Reuse immutable old drafts for the103 prior records; generate at most one new4B draft per new question at4096 context and512 total autoregressive tokens with one frozen configuration. No prompt, threshold or seed search. CPU6-thread host measurements are not Android execution. Preserve raw frames, span mappings, parser errors, every draft and complete rendered output.
Require zero unsupported eligible old/new/probe outputs, all nine existing absent controls and new absent controls withheld, and more than4/40 useful old answers; report precision, completeness, coverage and false rejections separately. Keep builder assessment separate from independent source review; preserve a negative outcome instead of weakening gates. Add behavioral and changed/missing artifact regressions. Update findings and release gaps. Selected4B Android admission/load/cancel/reload/resource qualification remains a separate approved-environment gate. No private holdout, production model/admission changes, services, global preferences, network inference, publication, push or main advancement. Do not dispatch or modify orchestration state.
